verdicts.reason: Both reduce the crowd illustration, the original's main image, to a thin strip of tiny figures. Both also wrap the quote into a narrow column whose long lines (THOUGHTFUL, COMMITTED, CAN CHANGE) almost touch the right edge, and both leave a dead white band at the bottom. A is slightly better because its crowd bleeds off the top edge like the original's. B's crowd is an even smaller inset strip with odd white space above it and a ragged crop.
